fusions.name: Printed Canard
fusions.desc: Floats a printed rumour into the first enemy it meets for 3 damage. Each hit has a 30% chance to leave the target [Damped] for 5 seconds, lowering the damage it deals.

fusions.name: Bill Come Due
fusions.desc: Skims an itemised bill at the target for 16 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at its maximum range of 6 tiles. It uses up every affliction you have on the target and deals 60% more damage for each one.

fusions.name: Waxed Sleeve
fusions.desc: For 3 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you.

fusions.name: Little Boat Afloat
fusions.desc: Once your health falls below 35%, you regain 4 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 45 seconds.
